name: hikari-user-field-evidence-and-contextual-de9c
instr:
Hikari cannot track immutable field-level evidence for what Discord supplied, explicitly nullified, Hikari defaulted, or left unavailable. Add this evidence to every PartialUser without changing established user behavior.

The public hikari facade exports `EvidenceState`, `EvidenceSource`, `UserFieldEvidence`, `EvidenceConflict`, `EvidenceIdentityError`, and `UserEvidence`. `EvidenceState` is a Enum, `EvidenceSource` is a Enum, and `EvidenceIdentityError` is a ValueError. Every PartialUser exposes evidence through `evidence(self)`. `UserEvidence.field(self, name)` retrieves an observation. `compare(self, other)` returns immutable conflicts sorted by field name, regardless of mapping insertion order. `prefer(self, other)` keeps the most informative observation per field, with explicit null authoritative.

Evidence records sources and applicable context identifiers without retaining mutable payload state. It remains stable when inputs are reordered, mutated, copied, or wrapped. UserImpl owns account evidence, TeamMember adds team evidence, Member adds guild evidence, and InteractionMember adds interaction permissions without relabeling nested account or guild observations. EntityFactory, gateway, and REST construction must consistently preserve supplied, omitted, explicitly null, and defaulted states, model types, nested users, and contextual fields.

Omitted flags report the established default as defaulted evidence without changing identity. REST-fetched users expose factory
